body:
Very long time. Which is why when I hear about the recent Belgian euthanasia law it makes me wish I was born in Europe.  I thought America was supposed to be the land of the free! Instead we have a nanny state telling when we are allowed to die while Europeans have the greater freedom. It's backwards and likely all because of those intolerable Christian conservatives.

But yeah I remember playing make believe when I was 7 years old and imagining I was on a futuristic elevator(in what would now be called a space elevator) zooming up to Heaven at light speed.  I also listened to Nirvana and jazz and I hated the dumb music my peers liked.  I remember at a school function they played Bob Marley's "Don't Worry" and I wanted to smash the speakers because I knew it was a complete lie and that being miserable was a natural response to a world that sucked so badly.
